definitions.gloss: prep school, cram school for university entrance
definitions.explanation: A school that prepares students for university entrance exams, often attended by students who failed or are preparing for exams.

examples.japanese: {予備校|よびこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}っている→通う：01217_kayou⟧。
⟦{浪人|ろうにん}→浪人：13301_rounin⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧{予備校|よびこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to prep school after taking a gap year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{有名|ゆうめい}な→有名：01106_yuumei⟧{予備校|よびこう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{競争|きょうそう}→競争：01388_kyousou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧。
examples.english: Famous prep schools are very competitive.

examples.japanese: {予備校|よびこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦わかりやすかった→わかりやすい：09582_wakariyasui⟧。
examples.english: The prep school teacher's classes were very easy to understand.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦{受験|じゅけん}→受験：04272_juken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{一年間|いちねんかん}→一年間：28882_ichinenkan⟧{予備校|よびこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}って→通う：01217_kayou⟧⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦つもり→つもり：01152_tsumori⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Since I failed the university entrance exam, I plan to attend prep school for a year and try again next year.

notes:
{予備校|よびこう} is a preparatory school focused on helping students pass university entrance exams. Short for ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦{受験|じゅけん}→受験：04272_juken⟧⟦{予備|よび}→予備：03993_yobi⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {予備校|よびこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}う→通う：01217_kayou⟧: to attend prep school
- {予備校|よびこう}⟦{生|せい}→〜生：noentry⟧: prep school student
- {予備校|よびこう}⟦{講師|こうし}→講師：00451_koushi⟧: prep school instructor

CULTURAL NOTE:
Often attended by ⟦{浪人生|ろうにんせい}→浪人生：20356_rouninsei⟧ — students who failed their target university's entrance exam and spend a year studying to retake it. Major prep school chains like {駿台|すんだい} and {河合塾|かわいじゅく} are well known in Japan.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{塾|じゅく}→塾：04702_juku⟧: cram school (broader term, used for students of all ages; includes after-school tutoring for younger students)
- ⟦{学習塾|がくしゅうじゅく}→学習塾：22118_gakushuujuku⟧: study cram school (mainly for elementary and junior high students)
